entities.title: Migrate a game's database, as a use case
entities.summary: docs/database-migrations.md describes a procedure the migration gate enforces, and no view shows it.
acceptanceCriteria: A use case in docs/.dev, Migrate a game's database: the owner as actor, GitHub supporting, the steps of database-migrations.md and the gate's refusals as alternatives.
A runbooks record for it, linked from each game's runbooks rather than copied into them.

origin.description: The owner asked for a plan to refactor retro-games so that it shows everything the cyberspace explorer can show, and approved its Phase 0.
